does: Evaluates one stats condition of a status (its RemoveConditions, or the OnApplyRoll / OnTickRoll / OnRemoveRoll of the event): builds the condition context from the status - its Target (+0x90) and StatusCause (+0xA8) entities and their positions - and evaluates the condition by index through the server's condition manager; returns the verdict.

evidence.says: its one caller is esv::Status::OnStatusEvent (two sites); it reads the status at +0x90 and +0xA8 and calls the condition evaluator at code:unplaced::EvaluateStatsCondition with the condition index it is given (the status's +0xF8 at one site, the prototype's per-event roll condition at the other)

a count-only probe while HOLD_PERSON's repeat save was rolled shows 2 calls, both from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x2FFC27F; the caller chain of See Invisibility's save on the revealed creature (SEE_INVISIBILITY_SEEN's OnApplyRoll, a Dexterity save) passes it from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x2FFBE61
